reviews.title: THIS IS NOT THE OFFICIAL GOOGLE APP!
reviews.text: Google does NOT have a forms app - this is a copy! Do not give access to your Google account. Do not pay for any subscriptions. It is a fake company exploiting people who are looking for the real Google Forms app. Google does not have an app, you can access Google forms ONLY through the official Google browser. There is no app, any app is just an imitation and will likely be phishing for information on your account or tricking you into paying for a subscription. PLEASE DO NOT DOWNLOAD!

reviews.title: Mobile version is clunky!
reviews.text: Google forms is such a great platform…as long as it’s on desktop. Editing, creating, and sharing forms is so simple and straightforward on desktop, BUT on mobile I always run in to issues doing the most basic things. My existing forms in my drive don’t always show up on my mobile app so finding my recent forms is never a guarantee, and it’s really difficult to retrieve information, edit questions, etc. I don’t pay for the premium version since I already have Google suite (seems ridiculous to get such an expensive upgrade just for the mobile). I just feel like it should have been improved by now given how smooth all other features in Google suite tend to be! Again—I love the desktop version of forms. But the mobile version frustrates me every time I try to use it.

reviews.title: Constant issues for a small business
reviews.text: I’ve made a handful of forms for my cookie orders. But as soon as you get to a certain amount of “triggers” (meaning I want notified when a customer submits an order), the forms don’t let you choose to have push/email notifications anymore without all kinds of tech coding deletion and causes so much frustration. I don’t know how to do that let alone have the time while I’m running a small business. I suggest looking elsewhere to create forms for your small business. I’m canceling.

reviews.title: Horrible! Couldn’t access my results.
reviews.text: I got this app because I needed to conduct a survey with over 30 responses for my chemistry project worth 50% of my grade. I conducted my survey on December 2, 2025 and got 39 responses. On December 10, 2025 I tried to access my results and it claimed I had none. I tried talking to the AI chatbot about it and it didn’t respond to my question. I am very disappointed. I have emailed customer support, and if I get one back by the end of this week and they find my results, I will update this review. If not, then stay away!!

I was so upset, all of my work and every question and piece of information was gone. I tried to get it back but nope 😐. Some of it was personal info from people I knew that I wouldn’t get back. I heard that someone else had this issue so I wanted to say something about it because it makes me angry to know that this happens often 😐
